_readme: Map each character to an ElevenLabs voice. Run `node tools/generate-voices.mjs --list-voices` to see ids available to your account, or pick Thai-capable voices in the Voice Library and add them to My Voices. Stability on Eleven v3: 0.0 Creative (most emotional, best for audio tags), 0.5 Natural, 1.0 Robust.
